title: Every Coder run stops in 1s: a Jev answer from the backup gateway door is refused as a different model
body:
Found while running the release gate for #10104 (2026-10-01, debug build of main): every Coder run (`delegate-now`, `push-main`) ends after ~1.4 s with "Coder stopped: the task was cancelled or reached its time limit."

The trace shows the hosted decision worker (`decision-worker@5ed35bf130`) failed over to the Vercel AI Gateway door (`service.door: https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh`), which answers as `typesafe-ai/jev`, its name for Jev (`jev::doors::GATEWAY_MODEL`). The repository adapter's native judge (`crates/microcoder/src/repository/native.rs`) compares the answer's model to the admitted `jev-1.13.0` literally, calls `host.fail("decision provider returned a model different from the admitted model")`, and the fault cancels the turn before its first model step.

Fix: the judge accepts an answer when its model is the admitted model as the answering door names it (`jev::doors::Naming`: canonical at TypeSafe, `typesafe-ai/jev` at the gateway, `typesafe/jev-1.13` at OpenRouter), and still refuses any other model.
